source: Hi. Make An FPS Shooter Game With A Loading GUI. Once Loaded On The Main Hub Screen, Have A Button Where It Says Play An When Clicking It. it Loads You Onto The Map\n\nMake The Map First. the Map Style Will Be Like The Hood But A Bit Different.

answers.ask: What mode is this - team deathmatch, free-for-all, or an objective?
answers.answer: Make it free-for-all so players spawn into the map and fight each other.

answers.ask: What should be different about your hood map compared to the one you have in mind?
answers.answer: Keep a hood/neighbourhood feel, but make it an original layout with different streets, buildings, and landmarks rather than copying a specific map.

answers.ask: How many blocks should the neighbourhood cover?
answers.answer: Use a small map covering about 4 city blocks so it is easy to play and build.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] goal — Q: What mode is this - team deathmatch, free-for-all, or an objective? A: Make it free-for-all so players spawn into the map and fight each other.
- [author] free — Q: What should be different about your hood map compared to the one you have in mind? A: Keep a hood/neighbourhood feel, but make it an original layout with different streets, buildings, and landmarks rather than copying a specific map.
- [author] scale — Q: How many blocks should the neighbourhood cover? A: Use a small map covering about 4 city blocks so it is easy to play and build.
- [agent_inferred] enterability — Q: Are the neighbourhood buildings playable interiors? A: Keep combat outdoors at street level and use building facades, because no interior play was requested.

## Enriched image prompt
Create an original small urban neighbourhood FPS map covering about four city blocks for free-for-all combat. Arrange distinct streets, alleys, building facades, and original neighbourhood landmarks into interconnected outdoor routes with several ways around each block. Distribute street-level cover and screened spawn pockets across the map while preventing long uninterrupted sightlines into arrival areas. Keep buildings exterior-only rather than adding playable interiors, and do not include menu or loading-screen elements.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Shooter.

## Shape and preset
Use `lane-network`, because the four-block street and alley grid channels movement through several interconnected firing routes. The matched preset is Arena Deathmatch, keeping its free-for-all lane shape and `path-loop` while omitting unrequested power-up and elevated-nest features.

## Config requirements
`path-loop` gives streets and alleys multiple connections rather than realistic dead ends. `cover-los` draws evenly distributed street-level cover using block corners, low walls, and simple urban props. `spawn-protected` draws screened arrival pockets throughout the neighbourhood. Universal `settlement-density` establishes about four contiguous city blocks, and the shared `landmark-focal` ID covers distinct original neighbourhood landmarks visible across those streets.

## Layout requirements
Place `spawn-protected` as evenly distributed free-for-all spawn markers around all four blocks, each backed by cover and outside immediate opposing sightlines; use no fixed count because the player cap was not supplied. Do not place team bases, capture zones, NPC emitters, or world pickups.

## Layout components
The map contains about four compact city blocks, a connected street-and-alley network, exterior-only building masses, varied original landmarks, distributed cover, and screened spawn pockets. Every block has more than one approach, and the outer street edge or building line forms the boundary. Compose the full neighbourhood grid in frame with all four blocks readable.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: interconnected street routes and safe spawn sightlines should be established before the urban facades and landmarks are dressed.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium: the map spans about four city blocks, but individual buildings, alleys, cover, and spawn pockets must remain legible. The theme is an original contemporary urban neighbourhood. `P0` is sufficient because the map is one grounded exterior surface with facade-only buildings and no overhang-dependent play.
